title: Point-by-point compositional analysis for atom probe tomography
author: Stephenson, Ceguerra, et al.

steps.title: Solution treat and quench
steps.instruction: Solution‑treat the alloy at 1150 °C for 30 min, then quench rapidly in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Secondary heat treatment
steps.instruction: Heat‑treat the alloy at 600 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Prepare atom‑probe specimen
steps.instruction: Prepare the atom‑probe sample using a FEI Nova Nanolab 200 SEM/FIB system.

steps.title: Configure LEAP settings
steps.instruction: Set the Cameca LEAP 3000XHR parameters to a specimen temperature of 45 K, pulse rate of 160 kHz, and target evaporation rate of 5 ions per 1000 pulses.

steps.title: Run atom‑probe analysis
steps.instruction: Perform laser‑assisted atom‑probe tomography on the prepared specimen with the LEAP 3000XHR, detecting 106 atoms.
